summary: The two interviews give contrasting portraits of how a living was made after arrival, and what it cost. Both begin with bureaucratic and economic conditions of departure: Mary Grande's account centers on a mother navigating multiple courts and offices, a fare downgrade, and clothes stolen in a Trieste holding space [mo399f49c956, mo00d7e05731, mofdda1edaa0, mo968899529a]; the Minnie Rodwin material follows a father recalled to the army, tickets purchased, and steerage passage at the bottom of the ship [mo7807b26f25, mo287f7078f6, mo3b643f48d1]. Livelihoods diverge sharply: decades of mine and smelter work, Depression-era alternating weeks, and nearly thirty years of packing-house piecework in the first account [mo55708f9b51, mo534b4b8fd3, mod0a2c906c4, mo2c3769e819, moa61019c788]; a Polish-Jewish bakery on Essex Street, kept for fifteen years, with children topping macaroons and brothers pulled from school in the second [mo76d6abaae2, mo5d43ee239f, mo40dcf633cd, mo85c5a35bc1, moaf5a3cf3f4]. Regional networks operate differently too: clustering with co-villagers in Utah mining towns and Denver versus kin scattered across New York with weekly bakery gatherings as anchor [mo27071377f1, mofe959b91e8, modd8470037c, mo561ec80cbd, moe62261b148]. The toll shows a father's mine-broken body, Mary Grande's repeated surgeries, and a daughter's medical exit from the smokehouse, alongside two sisters left in Poland and a four-story walkup [mo44f59417fb, moec459eb43d, mobb81224b14, moda5093ea04, mo31be8477cd, moaf2475854f]. Thin areas: financial texture beyond intermittent work; bakery economics; reunion outcomes.

theme_gists.gist: Both accounts show departure shaped by layered costs: bureaucratic gauntlets, fare downgrades, stolen possessions, and army recall, with steerage or downgraded accommodations as the physical baseline [mo399f49c956, mo00d7e05731, mofdda1edaa0, mo968899529a, mo7807b26f25, mo287f7078f6, mo3b643f48d1].

Livelihoods split between mine, smelter, and packing-house work marked by Depression precarity and three decades of meat cutting, and a bakery carried by the wife for fifteen years before relocation [mo55708f9b51, mo534b4b8fd3, mo2c3769e819, moa61019c788, mofa2d09a819, mo76d6abaae2, mo5d43ee239f, mo40dcf633cd].
